description:
Outcome: Coordinator sees a grid of 40 plots and holders, from brief.md First version must 5 deferred by owner until after first version
Scope: Responsive coordinator-only 40-plot grid using persisted assignments, occupied/vacant states, accessible list alternative. Excludes: allocation-rule changes, gardener-wide directory, payments and tools
Acceptance: Exactly 40 labelled plots; holders/vacancies match persisted assignments; no contact exposure to non-coordinators; phone, keyboard and screen-reader usable
Behaviour: Loading/empty/error/retry states and refresh after assignment changes
Verification: Role-boundary and grid/data consistency tests plus mobile/keyboard/accessibility checks. Prerequisites: T-007, T-013. Assumptions: none
title: Coordinator 40-plot map after first version
